parsed.degree_signal: Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field; advanced degree a plus.
parsed.notes:
The requirements section is required by default; Preferred Attributes makes its items nice_to_have.
LLMs and AI agents are alternatives under the explicit and/or wording; responsibility-only mentions do not create independent requirements.
Operating production ML systems is mapped literally to MLOps; data infrastructure is not assumed to mean AI infrastructure.
Concrete detection and evaluation techniques in Preferred Attributes are retained as unmapped where no taxonomy entry fits; fraud and adversarial-domain knowledge and soft skills are excluded.
The optional advanced degree names no specific higher level, so the degree label remains bachelor rather than inferring master or PhD.
No German-language requirement is stated.
